prompt: Which MP standing as the leader of a major party in the 2019 United Kingdom General Election was also an MP for Henley?
answer: Boris Johnson. He was the Conservative Party leader and stood in Uxbridge and South Ruislip in the 2019 general election; he had previously been MP for Henley from 2001 to 2008.
